Name: Colored Shelves for Alternative Texture
Author: BethKitten
Description:
[size=3]Like the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10862]Wooden Shelves[/url] but not the color of them because they match your house deco?  Or just want a way to organize your prizes? Then this might be the answer you are looking for.

I really like the idea of having somewhere to showcase items, but I did not like the color of the shelves.  So I decided to do something about it.

 This is my first attempt at making an Alternative Texture pack, so please let me know if something is not working for you ([color=red]smapi log a must[/color]).

Each of the 3 different versions: single, double, and triple each has a choice of 10 different colors.

Colors are:
﻿Black
﻿Blue
﻿Cream
﻿Dark Wood
﻿Gray
﻿Green
﻿Lavender
﻿Oak
﻿Red
﻿White
﻿
Hope you enjoy!

If you want to see my other mods,  then please visit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/117914948?tab=user+files]here[/url][/size]
